body:
src/emit_java.c/.h wired into parena build's -o extension dispatch (.java). Same narrow v0 scope as emit_ts.c (scalar params, one-expression body, shared math/* primitive table via java.lang.Math's real name overlap with JS Math). Two real Java-specific differences: = -> ==, and every defn wrapped in one public final class matching the output basename (javac requirement). tests/test_emit_java.c: 23 assertions, bazel test //tests:test_emit_java passes. Verified with a real javac (JDK 25.0.4, EINHORN_SURVIVAL/jdk25): the same unmodified stdlib/mishri/bezier_interp.prn + humanness.prn already proven for C and TS compiled a third time, actually javac'd to .class with zero errors, smoke-tested via a real Main.java. Commit 2cebd07.

⚓ ☃
title: Real v0 Java emitter shipped -- third PARENA compilation target
